notice: These notes describe recorded source and local builds, not the version installed on a particular server or device. No public release or automatic update availability is implied. Historical entries were reconstructed on 2026-11-09; missing evidence is stated explicitly.

entries.title: Changes awaiting a new release
changes: Expanded automatic routing: model explanations, model-choice feedback, route previews, model-profile catalogs and per-step routing history.
Automatic model selection for Quick Build, plus richer usage and cost reporting.
Bundled release history available to Studio assistant and local help, with a release-notes requirement for future builds.
Fallback notices say a provider answered only after the run completes.
Studio's model-router deadline is configurable from 1 to 120 seconds, with a 20-second default to accommodate classifier work before falling back.
limitations: These changes are not evidence that an existing desktop build or hosted Studio includes them.
The related disabled-provider routing fix belongs to the separate Nexus Router repository and requires its own deployment.

entries.title: Built-in desktop model router
changes: Desktop source adds a bundled Nexus Router and workspace runtime.json support.
Studio source adds Auto provider selection, provider fallback, reported token usage, and Router and OpenClaw operational panels.
limitations: Local signing metadata records accepted app and DMG notarization; no release date or complete frozen source manifest is archived with that record.
Source version 1.0.6 was recorded on 2026-11-08. This is not a verified release date.
Later routing improvements remain under Unreleased; the version number alone does not prove they were packaged.
Release files remain local; no public updater feed was published.

entries.title: Clear loading and subscription status
changes: One conversation loading indicator replaces duplicate Working text; response controls stay hidden while pending, and reduced-motion preferences are respected.
Providers & models offers Sign in and Reconnect for installed subscription CLIs, with read-only Codex, Claude Code and Antigravity status checks.
Antigravity model listing can confirm signed-in status without making a generation request.
The Apple Silicon package includes the full SDK profile and signature-verified update support.
limitations: Signed and notarized local DMG; public update feed is unpublished.
Provider CLIs, accounts, Docker and voice model weights are separate prerequisites.

entries.title: Local provider sign-in and verified badges
changes: The installed Mac application adds provider Sign in and Reconnect actions and verified Codex and Claude Code status badges.
Local update installation preserves the existing workspace and retains a verified backup of the previous application.
limitations: This was a signed and notarized local application installation. No new DMG was produced.
Later Antigravity status and conversation loader fixes are recorded under 1.0.5.

entries.title: Native Nexus account controls
changes: Native Account menu starts browser-based Nexus sign-in with a PKCE-protected return to the Mac and Keychain session storage.
Account controls include device sign-out, cancellation of pending sign-in, and guided setup for installed Codex, Claude Code and Antigravity CLIs.
limitations: Nexus sign-in requires compatible desktop authentication endpoints and a registered identity-provider callback on the chosen server.
Local Studio remains usable without Nexus account sign-in. Nexus identity and provider subscription sign-in are separate.
Signed and notarized local DMG; not a public updater release.

entries.title: First recorded Developer ID signed release
changes: Developer ID signed and Apple-notarized Apple Silicon app and DMG with stapled tickets.
Signature- and version-verified native updates preserve a stopped workspace and the previous app before installation.
Full SDK packaging includes standalone PDF and MCP runtime checks, MCP cleanup fixes and evaluation report export.
limitations: The public updater feed was not published. Earlier ad-hoc builds require manual replacement.
Other physical devices and installed Windows/Linux acceptance were separate checks.

entries.title: No independent release established
limitations: The archived update drill used 1.0.1 as synthetic previous-version metadata. It does not establish a separate shipped release or its features.

entries.title: Standalone Mac beta foundation
changes: A native desktop shell runs the Studio UI and a bundled local Python backend.
Core and connected Apple Silicon packages were checked for standalone startup, workspace locking, backend shutdown and child-process cleanup.
limitations: The date is the beta verification checkpoint, not an established public release date. Source configuration recorded version 1.0.0.
These beta packages used ad-hoc signing; Developer ID signing and notarization were added later.
